"""Negative control, rule 3: an external-effect port (the host_os spawn chokepoint) is called inside the block."""
from codex_harness.host_os.adapters import process_groups


class Unit:
    def commit(self, task):
        with self.store.transaction() as tx:
            self.ops.record(tx, task)
            process_groups.popen(["true"])
        return task
